content.title: The Masked Singer spoilers: Who is Galaxy Girl?
content.text: Galaxy Girl on The Masked SingerMichael Becker/Fox Warning: this item includes The Masked Singer spoilers for Season 14 — read at your own risk! Galaxy Girl blasted onto The Masked Singer Season 14 premiere — and while the panel tossed out guesses like Lindsay Lohan, Jennifer Love Hewitt, and Emma Stone, Gold Derby believes the mystery singer is Ashlee Simpson. In her audio clue, Galaxy Girl described performing professionally before she could even drive, which fits Simpson’s early start as a trained dancer and backup performer for sister Jessica Simpson. She also spoke about walking away from perfection and fading into the background — a clear parallel to Ashlee’s meteoric mid-2000s pop rise, followed by a very public step back from the spotlight. The visuals line up just as well. A glowing heart-shaped rock reflects her emotional, confessional pop-rock persona, while the constellation and shooting star imagery mirror her rapid ascent to fame. A “Welcome 2 LA” sign points to her Hollywood upbringing, and the daily calendar set to Friday the 13th may be a playful nod to her song "Just Let Me Cry" featured on the soundtrack for 2003’s Freaky Friday. Add in Galaxy Girl’s love of performing and desire to have fun onstage, and the clues paint a familiar comeback story. All signs point to Ashlee Simpson. Gold Derby’s guess: Ashlee SimpsonAshlee SimpsonPhoto : Noam Galai/Getty Images for MTVAshlee Simpson is a singer, actress, and television personality who rose to fame in the early 2000s with her debut album Autobiography. The record spawned the hit single “Pieces of Me” and cemented her place in the pop-rock era of the time. She later expanded into acting with roles on 7th Heaven and Melrose Place. She is married to actor and performer Evan Ross. Galaxy Girl Performance 1: “Super Graphic Ultra Modern Girl”Galaxy Girl on the special two-hour Season 14 premiere of 'The Masked Singer' on Fox. Photo : Trae Patton/ FOX. Audio Clue: "Star light, star bright, heard you're looking for stars tonight. Well, this girl's the whole galaxy. From a young age I was on top of the world, accepted in the best schools on scholarship — the youngest on stage, all before I could even drive. But y'all, I'm human! And perfection was never my thing, so I walked away. For years, I was lost in the background, but I knew there was something even bigger in the world for me. So I worked my butt off — and boom — my rise was meteoric. Now I'm feeling another gravitational pull — towards this stage. I'll admit, I've been curious about doing The Masked Singer for awhile. And I'm ready takeoff, but I don't plan to take off this mask until I secure that trophy." Visual Clues: Glowing heart-shaped rock, a constellation, a shooting star, a sign that read "Welcome 2 LA," and a daily calendar set to Friday the 13th. What is your strategy to win the Golden Mask trophy? "My strategy is, I want to have fun! I want to perform for you guys — I love a crowd! Let's all get together and have the best time." Panelist Guesses: Lindsay Lohan (Rita), Jennifer Love Hewitt (Jenny), and Emma Stone (Ken). Galaxy Girl Performance 2: “Just a Girl”Galaxy Girl on "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Night" of 'The Masked SingerPhoto : Michael Becker/Fox Audio Clue: "I know firsthand, when you spend your life in front of cameras, people try to control your every move — especially as a woman. They try to tell you what to where, how to talk, your whole image. But I am not here for all of that. The night before one of the biggest shoots of my life, I changed my look and I didn't tell anybody. The next day, when they saw what I'd done, everyone panicked. But they don't know what's best for me — I do! And I was right, the shoot went global. Oh, and my look? Iconic!" Visual Clues: Galaxy Girl as a news anchor, shopping bags, New York Times best sellers, a surfboard (Teen Choice Awards?), a closed for business sign, and a bowl of oranges. Secret Clue: Jingle bells. Galaxy Girl says, "Holidays are definitely an important time in my career. I love the holidays and the cheer!" Panelist Guesses: Dixie D'Amelio (Rita), Anne Hathaway (Ken), Hilary Duff (Jenny). Galaxy Girl Performance 3: “Drive”Galaxy Girl performance 3 on The Masked SingerPhoto : Trae Patton/Fox Audio Clue: "It's an honor to tribute Ozzy tonight — especially at Ozzfest. My first concert was Lilith Fair. I remember seeing the girls up on the stage being like, 'Ugh! I want to be you.' For years, I was lost in the background — I wasn't the one who sang. So, I kept that dream a secret. I would wait until everyone left the house, I'd sit by the piano and sing at the top of my lungs — just me. When I finally built up the confidence to tell my family, they didn't want me to get my hopes up — or worse — fail. I was so nervous to sing. I was expecting the worst, but I was totally good! Eventually, those festivals I dreamed of as a kid didn't seem so impossible after all." Visual Clues: A Lilith Fair bracelet, a spider, a boat, a record called "Dream" with clouds on it, and a clock set at 10:10. Ozzfest clue: "Halo." Galaxy Girl said, "Not everyone earns a halo in life, but in my lifetime, this girl sure did!" Panelist Guesses: Ashlee Simpson (Kelly), Kate Hudson (Jenny), Gwen Stefani (Ken) Galaxy Girl Performance 4: “Lights”Galaxy Girl on "Star Trek Night" of 'The Masked Singer'Photo : Michael Becker/Fox Audio Clue: "I've boldly gone where no one has gone before. And while your guesses have been out of this world, Ken, there are some major black holes in your constellation map. Spoiler alert! I am not Gwen Stefani." Colossal Star Trek Clue: Las Vegas showgirls. Galaxy Girl said, "My husband may love his slot machines, but when I go to Vegas I'm not there to gamble, I'm there to work." Panelist Guesses: Taylor Momsen (Robin), Avril Lavigne (Rita), Hilary Duff (Jenny) Galaxy Girl Performance 5: “Misery Business”Galaxy Girl performs in the semi-finals of The Masked SingerPhoto : Trae Patton/Fox Audio Clue: "The truth to my identity has been tucked away in this case file all season. But with the finale so close, there's a little detail I should probably share with you — this necklace. I've looked up to one star my whole life. By day, we'd sing karaoke in her convertible, but by night she took the world's biggest stages by storm. I watched in awe. I saw the awards, the glitz, the glam — but I also saw the public scrutiny, the headlines. I remember how much my heart would break for her. When it was my turn in the spotlight, I was scared to follow in her footsteps. But she prepared me for what was to come and she's always been my guiding light. That doesn't mean there's not some healthy competition — that's why I want to get to the finale. She may be a massive star, but I'm the whole galaxy. I win!" Visual clues: A "Best Friends" necklace Personal Connection Clue: Nick Cannon.In her Q&A with Nick, we learned Galaxy Girl's husband is better friends with him than she is. Galaxy Girl has known Nick since the early 2000s, but she's never been on Wild'n Out — she was never invited! Panelist Guesses: Ashlee Simpson (Rita and Jenny), Allie Michalka (Robin) Galaxy Girl Performance 6: Stay tuned'The Masked Singer' logoPhoto : FoxGalaxy Girl will return to perform again on The Masked Singer Season 14 at a later date.
